about: External line search for the 2026-10-25 card. Session cb84d7dc. Question: can any established LoL betting site, esportsbook or esports odds aggregator price the matches that the featured (market) resolution cannot? Every entry below is one page read during this session's 14:04-14:08Z window; captured_utc is inside that window and is accurate to the minute only as the session fetch time, not to the second.

coverage_observations.observation: Cloudbet maintains a dedicated Prime League 2nd Division market page, so it is a venue that CAN price this league at times - but on 2026-10-25 the page carried no event at all. The league that supplies 36 of the 241 Hotspawn cards had no open price on the one established book that advertises it.
coverage_observations.verbatim: No Prime League 2nd Division events availableCheck back later for the latest updates on upcoming matches.

coverage_observations.observation: The LoL lobby of the same book listed exactly one competition with events on 2026-10-25: the LoL World Championship. No national division, academy league or regional split appeared in the competition list.

The match centre's 'today' schedule for 2026-10-25 contained four LoL cards, all under 'Worlds 2026', each with a two-sided decimal pair (Hanwha Life 1.25 / Invictus Gaming 3.50; Top Esports 2.05 / G2 1.68; Dplus KIA 1.22 / KOI 3.80; Gen.G 1.04 / LYON 8.00). Not one of the 147 upcoming national and academy cards that Hotspawn lists appeared on it.

coverage_observations.observation: The cross-book comparison listed four LoL events for 2026-10-25, all in the World Championship, each quoted by 24-27 bookmakers. No tier-2, national or academy LoL competition appeared anywhere in its esports schedule for the day.

coverage_observations.observation: The comparison engine's entire League of Legends index contains one competition, and the count in brackets is the number of priced events: the World Championship with 10. Every one of the other 28 competitions on the Hotspawn list is absent from the index.

GG.BET served a geo-restriction notice instead of a LoL lobby, so no price could be read from it from this location on this date. This is a different verdict from the Actions runner's HTTP 403 on the same host and is recorded separately rather than resolved either way.
coverage_observations.verbatim: This internet site is not accepting visitors from your region. If you have any questions please address them to support@gg.bet

coverage_observations.observation: Vave, which EGamersWorld quotes as a book on every Worlds match, refused this location outright. Its prices are therefore only visible through the aggregator that mirrors them, not from the book itself.
coverage_observations.verbatim: Vave is currently not available in your region

coverage_observations.observation: Rivalry, previously one of the larger esportsbooks quoted in this project's own source probes, has ceased trading: the LoL URL now redirects to an operational-closure notice. It should be removed from any list of candidate venues rather than retried.
coverage_observations.verbatim: Rivalry's operations have now ceased. Player access is no longer available through this site.

coverage_observations.observation: Thunderpick's entire League of Legends category was 11 markets on two competitions: Worlds 2026 (10) and LGC Rising 2026 Playoffs (1). It does price one lower-tier competition that Hotspawn also lists, which is why the LGC Rising card below carries a fresh second-venue capture, but it does not list the PRM divisions, RIVALS LEAGUE, the Tunisian Super League or any other Hotspawn tail competition.
